investment_policy_en:
Since 2005, ODDO BHF Polaris Moderate has offered a global and broadly diversified, moderate multi-asset investment solution. It is characterized by an equity allocation between 0% and 40% and a bond segment that invests mainly in investment grade bonds.

The portfolio invests in securities listed or traded on regulated markets, mainly in Europe, the US or Emerging Markets. It can also invest up to 10% in gold by certificates or similar.

The investment objective is to avoid major setbacks due to price fluctuations and to generate an additional return to a bond investment, while taking into account environmental, social issues and corporate governance (ESG) criteria.
